Raiden is a payment channel network built on Ethereum for fast, low-cost token transfers. Raiden executes transfers off-chain through state channels and settles them on the Ethereum blockchain. Raiden is open source and was developed by Brainbot Technologies.

Diem was a blockchain-based payment project originally announced as Libra by a consortium led by Facebook. Diem was designed to support a stablecoin backed by a reserve of assets. Diem used the Move programming language for its smart contracts. Diem operated as a permissioned network governed by the Diem Association rather than as a public permissionless blockchain. Diem was wound down in early 2022.

Terra Station is a web wallet and dashboard for the Terra blockchain. Terra Station lets users manage Terra-based assets such as UST and LUNA. Terra Station provides access to staking on the Terra network. Terra Station was developed by Terraform Labs.

SushiSwap is a decentralized exchange that operates as an automated market maker. SushiSwap was forked from Uniswap in 2020. SushiSwap is governed by holders of its SUSHI token. SushiSwap offers additional services such as lending and yield farming alongside token swapping.

PYUSD is a stablecoin launched by PayPal. PYUSD is pegged to the US dollar at a one-to-one ratio. PYUSD is issued by Paxos. PYUSD is initially issued as an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum blockchain.
